title: No Support of Sony Smartwatch 3 SW50 since latest DEV (2.8.2) version
symptom: The user reports that after updating to AAPS 2.8.2 DEV, the Sony Smartwatch 3 SW50 is no longer updated; installing the watch APK via ADB fails, whereas the master version works.
evidence_quote: I'm sorry. I cannot check that again, because I switched to the new Samsung Watch 4. Before that I stayed on the master 2.8.1 and that was ok on the SWR50. As you mentioned, it seems that in RC3 the problems are solved. So, in my opinion , this issue can be closed.
